_meta.purpose: Scout agent research library — RSS feeds and APIs checked before web search each run
_meta.usage: Scout reads this file at run start. For each source: fetch RSS feed or call API, filter by topic_tags matching the article brief, pass summaries to Quill's research brief.
notes: Sources marked requires_key:true need an env var set in agents/.env
All rate_limit values are free-tier limits
Sources are roughly ordered: no-key first, key-required last within each section

apis.name: arXiv API
apis.rate_limit: 1 req/3 sec (no key); 10 req/sec (with institutional key)
apis.notes: Use for targeted search on article topics. Prefer keyword search over broad RSS when you have a specific research question.

apis.name: PubMed E-utilities
apis.notes: Biomedical and life sciences literature. Free, no key needed. Pair esearch (find IDs) with efetch (get abstracts).

apis.name: Crossref API
apis.rate_limit: unlimited (polite pool); add mailto=joselitovsering@gmail.com to requests
apis.notes: DOIs, titles, abstracts across journals. Include mailto param for polite pool — faster response.

apis.name: The Guardian Open Platform
apis.notes: Full Guardian articles by section. Sections: artanddesign, music, film, stage, travel, culture, books, science, society, global-development. Strong for opinion and in-depth angles.

apis.name: New York Times Article Search
apis.notes: Article search, top stories, archives. Filter by section_name: Arts, Travel, Movies, Theater, Style. Good for US and international current events.

apis.name: NewsAPI
apis.notes: Aggregates 80k+ sources worldwide. Use category=entertainment for arts/culture. Filter to financial domains for market news.

apis.name: GNews API
apis.notes: Google News-indexed stories. Use topic=business for finance/markets focus.

apis.name: Currents API
apis.notes: Real-time and historical news. Category filters available.

apis.name: MediaStack API
apis.notes: Live news, multi-language. Useful for international and non-English-first stories.

apis.name: Event Registry
apis.notes: Event-based news discovery with sentiment, impact, and trend signals. Best for finding angle on breaking events.

apis._note: These are data sources, not news feeds. Scout uses these to pull quantitative indicators that back article claims — GDP figures, health stats, trade volumes, demographic trends.

apis.name: World Bank API
apis.notes: 8,000+ indicators for 200+ countries. Key indicators: SP.POP.TOTL (population), NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (GDP), SI.POV.DDAY (poverty), SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS (health spending). Append &date=YYYY:YYYY for time range.

apis.name: IMF Data API
apis.notes: SDMX-JSON protocol. Key datasets: IFS (International Financial Statistics), DOTS (trade), GFS (fiscal), WEO (World Economic Outlook). Registration required but generous limits.

apis.name: FRED — Federal Reserve Economic Data
apis.notes: 816,000+ time series from 100+ sources. Key series: GDP, CPIAUCSL (inflation), UNRATE (unemployment), FEDFUNDS (interest rates), DFF (fed funds). Best for US economic data.

apis.name: UN SDG Data API
apis.notes: UN Sustainable Development Goals indicators. Covers poverty, hunger, health, education, gender equality, clean energy, and more across all 17 SDGs. No key required.

apis.name: UN Comtrade
apis.notes: Commodity trade data — imports/exports by country and trading partner. Best for global trade articles. Free key after registration.

apis.name: OECD Data API
apis.notes: OECD official statistics via SDMX-JSON. Datasets: HEALTH_STAT, PIAAC (skills), EAG (education), MEI (macroeconomic indicators), ENV (environment). No key required.

apis.name: Eurostat API
apis.notes: EU statistical office — economy, population, energy, health, transport. Best for EU-focused articles. SDMX-JSON and REST. No key required.

apis.name: Google Trends (via pytrends)
apis.example: pip install pytrends — then: TrendReq().build_payload(['AI', 'jobs'], geo='', timeframe='today 12-m')
apis.rate_limit: unofficial; may be rate-limited or blocked without delay()
apis.notes: No official API — pytrends is the standard Python workaround. Add time.sleep(1) between requests to avoid throttling. Use for trend direction, not absolute figures. May break without warning.

apis.name: Our World in Data
apis.notes: Long-run global data on health, energy, education, poverty, and inequality. All charts downloadable as CSV. Not a live API — static snapshots updated regularly. Excellent for historical trend data.

apis.name: Trading Economics
apis.notes: 20M+ time series — real-time economic indicators, stock markets, commodities, currencies. Free tier is limited; best for cross-country economic comparisons.

apis.name: Nasdaq Data Link (formerly Quandl)
apis.notes: Large collection of economic, social, and financial time series from official sources. Access FRED, World Bank, and other datasets through a unified API. Attribution required.

apis.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
apis.notes: Official US labor market data — unemployment, CPI, PPI, wages, productivity. Key series: CES (employment), CPI (inflation), ECI (employment cost). Essential for US labor and economy articles.

apis.name: U.S. Census Bureau API
apis.rate_limit: 500 queries/day without key; higher with key
apis.notes: US population, demographics, housing, and business data. Key surveys: ACS (American Community Survey), Decennial Census. Good for US inequality, race, immigration articles.

apis.name: Data.gov API
apis.notes: CKAN API aggregating thousands of US open government datasets. Use package_search to find datasets, then download via datastore_search. Good for finding niche government data.

apis.name: CDC WONDER
apis.notes: US public health data — births, deaths, cancer, disease prevalence. Complex XML POST format. Best for US mortality, disease burden, and public health articles. No key, but complex to query.

apis.name: Finnhub
apis.notes: Company news, market news, press releases. Ticker-specific news ideal for algorithmic trading context articles.

apis.name: IEX Cloud
apis.notes: News per symbol or general market news. Machine-readable format ideal for trading bot or dashboard context.

apis.name: Polygon.io
apis.notes: Aggregated financial news articles. Ticker-specific filtering available. Good for quant/trading angle research.

apis.name: Alpaca Markets News
apis.notes: US equities news feed. Free with paper-trading account — no live trading required. Keys passed as request headers, not query params.

local_data_paths.description: Pre-cached CSVs and JSONs dropped here are picked up automatically by Scout at run start. Useful for pre-loaded datasets, webhook outputs, or manual research drops.
local_data_paths.notes: Scout reads all files in this directory before fetching any external source.

topic_tag_index._note: Tags used across sources for topic matching. Scout filters sources by matching article brief keywords against these tags.
